title: button max three words mobile full width
name: Button: max three words; full width on mobile — Suomi.fi
rule: Button label ≤3 words; verb; capital first letter; full-width on mobile, shrink-to-content on desktop. Inverted variant not on images unless contrast holds. Dual-cite Actions explicit verb; unique bits are the three-word cap and mobile full-width.
pass_when: Action labels ≤3 words, verb-first, capital first letter; small screens span the viewport; desktop width follows the label; inverted not on images unless contrast holds.
fail_when: Action label longer than three words; mobile button does not span the viewport; desktop is a fixed wide block; inverted on an image without contrast.
overview: Action labels stay ≤3 words, verb-first; full-width on mobile, shrink-to-content on desktop.
apply_when: Labeling primary and secondary buttons in Suomi.fi forms and flows.
not_when: Long help links, multi-sentence instructions, or icon-only controls with accessible names.
agent_hint: Cap button labels at three verb-first words; full-width mobile, content-width desktop.
description: Suomi.fi buttons use at most three words, start with a verb, capitalize the first letter, span the viewport on mobile, and shrink to content on desktop. Inverted variants stay off images unless contrast holds. Longer labels, fixed wide desktop blocks, mobile buttons that do not span, or inverted-on-image without contrast fail the pattern. Dual-cite explicit-verb action guidance; the unique bits here are the three-word cap and mobile full-width.
do_not_claim: One primary per view; Actions explicit-verb without the three-word cap.
